bio:
Ann K. Meier, known in the family as Nancy, was born about 1963 or 1964 and grew up in Levittown, Pennsylvania, one of the eight children of James C. and Kathryn (McGuire) Meier and a younger sister of John's father, Tommy. She married Anthony 'Tony' Russo and they live in Doylestown, Bucks County, where they raised four children: Anthony Jr., Chelsea, Gianna and Emily.

The family's football line ran on through her son. Anthony Russo Jr., born in Doylestown in 1997, quarterbacked Archbishop Wood to Catholic League and state titles, set passing records at Temple University from 2018 to 2020, finished his college career at Michigan State and played professionally in 2023. His college bios name Nancy and Tony as his parents and note that his uncle Dan Meier played football at North Carolina State.
